cabello_002.query: Tratamiento para cabello dañado por decoloración

cejas_008.query: Remoción de microblading mal hecho: opciones y riesgos
cejas_008.miss_type: CORPUS_MISS (FTS also fails) - chunks may not exist or not match lexically

cejas_004.query: Corrección de cejas asimétricas con micropigmentación
cejas_004.miss_type: VECTOR_MISS + LEXICAL_MISS (FTS also fails) - semantic gap not bridgeable by keywords

CORPUS.evidence: cejas_008: 3/6 GOLD missing; FTS recovers 0. Chunks may not exist in corpus or use non-matching terminology. Need corpus audit.

RETRIEVAL.evidence: K=50/100/200 (R6-C7) showed no additional GOLD. Vector retrieval ceiling is not K-bound.

EMBEDDING_REPRESENTATION.evidence: cejas_004: 4/6 GOLD VECTOR_MISS + LEXICAL_MISS. Embedding space fails to represent 'simetria/asimétricas' concepts. FTS on 'asimétricas' also fails. R6-RECOVERY-3 confirmed managed NVIDIA model non-reproducible.

FTS.evidence: Recovers 1/9 missing GOLD (cabello_002 'metales'). Fails on cejas_004 (semantic terms) and cejas_008 (corpus/terminology gap). Spanish FTS limited for technical concepts.

HYBRID_RETRIEVAL.evidence: HYBRID_ALWAYS: +1 GOLD, +0.033 MRR. ADAPTIVE: No gate achieves all 3 criteria (recover GOLD + preserve MRR + reduce FTS>=30%). Gate A saves FTS but loses GOLD.

EVIDENCE_CANDIDATES.evidence: R6-C2 Candidate Builder: structural improvement (R@5 0->0.1333) but 0 new GOLD recovered. Techo R@50 invariant.

EVIDENCE_GROUPING.evidence: R6-C4 Grouping: no recall improvement over raw retrieval.

SUFFICIENCY.evidence: R6-C5: 432 configs, 0 SAFE-PASS. Gate incompatible with R6 score distribution (max 0.50-0.57 vs 0.65+ required).

PROVENANCE.evidence: R6-C8/R6-C9 tracked VECTOR/FTS/BOTH provenance. Confirmed FTS adds distinct chunk (colorimetria-capilar-metales-003) not in vector pool.

R6-C7.hypothesis: K=200 + category boost + reranking breaks retrieval ceiling
R6-C7.evidence: K=200 R@50=0.3333 ceiling; 0 new GOLD; category boost degrades MRR; reranking degrades MRR

R6-C8.hypothesis: FTS recovers VECTOR_MISS (especially cejas_004) via lexical match
R6-C8.evidence: FTS recovers 1 GOLD (cabello_002 'metales'); cejas_004 0/4 recovered; cejas_008 0/3 recovered

R6-C9.hypothesis: Adaptive gating (low vector confidence) recovers GOLD while reducing FTS calls
R6-C9.evidence: No gate satisfies all 3 criteria. Gate A (73% FTS reduction) loses the only recoverable GOLD. Gates B-E (93-100% activation) = HYBRID_ALWAYS with no savings.

next_cycle.recommended: R6-C10: Corpus Expansion + Embedding Model Evaluation
next_cycle.rationale: Root cause is EMBEDDING_REPRESENTATION (CONFIRMADO) + CORPUS gaps (PARCIAL). Retrieval improvements (K, hybrid, gating) exhausted. 8/9 missing GOLD are not recoverable by current vector+lexical methods on current corpus.

criteria: No adaptive gate recovers GOLD while preserving MRR >= vector AND reducing FTS calls >=30%
Best gate (A) saves 73% FTS but recovers 0 GOLD (misses cabello_002 activation)
Gates B-E recover 1 GOLD but activate FTS on 93-100% queries (no savings)
cejas_004: FTS activation adds latency with 0 benefit (false activation)
decision.root_cause: Adaptive gating cannot distinguish 'recoverable VECTOR_MISS' from 'unrecoverable VECTOR_MISS' using top1_score signal. The one recoverable case (cabello_002) has top1_score=0.555 (above Gate A threshold).
decision.recommendation: Do NOT implement adaptive hybrid. Do NOT implement hybrid always. Proceed to Corpus Expansion (R6-C10) or Embedding Model change.
